services.name: Turtle Snorkeling Adventure + Guaranteed Sightings
services.desc: Enjoy the Magic of Waikiki Turtle Canyon Snorkeling with Hawaiian Green Sea Turtles! Join us for a two-hour adventure aboard "Kealoha" to the shallow, inner, coral reefs located at the world-famous Waikiki “Turtle Canyon”. Our Turtle Canyon snorkeling tour gives you more than enough time to get acquainted with your new green friends. Be amazed at the underwater world that lives just offshore of Waikiki Beach! Vessel Kealoha is a 55ft Sailing Catamaran with an inside seating area, two trampolines on the bow, and a bar serving mixed drinks and canned beverages. Snorkel and Sail All ages • 2 Hours

Now is your chance to experience majestic Humpback whales up close, so let’s embark on this once-in-a-lifetime experience together! services.name: Sunset Whale Watch (Dec 15 - April 15)
services.desc: Sunset Whale Watch (Wahine Koa) This two-for-one cruise package combines two of our most popular excursions into one tour. Our spectacular Waikiki Sunset Cruise and our exhilarating Whale Watching Adventure. Experience the thrill of watching majestic Humpback Whales frolic in the beautiful waters off Waikiki as our guides educate you on their migration habits and other fun facts. And as the day turns to night, take in the most breathtaking sunset and witness an array of amazing colors that you can only see in our special part of the world. quotes.author: Michelle
quotes.text: We had a fabulous time swimming with turtles off Waikiki beach. The crew were informative, friendly, entertaining and welcoming. I went with my husband and sisters and we all had a ball. It was definitely a highlight of our trip. I would highly recommend this activity.

I have taken multiple sunset tours in Hawaii. None of them let you swim. This was amazing. My kids and I swam in the ocean, we saw turtles and seals, they had free snacks and drinks for purchase. The crew was so chill and friendly. I highly recommend this tour!

quotes.author: Leanne C
quotes.text: It was truly amazing 🤩 saw a lot of turtles 🐢 tropical fish, water was crystal clear, staff on boat were friendly an very helpful, was highlight of my holiday so far would highly recommend 🙌

quotes.author: Dr Keith
quotes.text: What an amazing experience. The staff was wonderful and went above and beyond our expectations. I highly recommend Pink Sails Waikiki when visiting the islands. This is a must do experience.
